Any AI can build you an app in minutes.
Getting it to production still takes months.
Because production isn't a prototype. It's a process.
Kissflow's Agentic App Builder runs that process — every step of it.
It starts with your requirements. Agents read the BRD and map every role, rule and journey.
Specialist agents design the data, the workflows, the permissions and the screens. In parallel.
After every step, a verifier tries to break it. Lockouts. Dead ends. A bad formula. It fixes them — and checks again.
What you get isn't just an app. It's a Blueprint.
Nine documents your business, IT and auditors can read — before a single screen exists.
Every decision is logged. Every open question is asked. Nothing gets built until you say so.
Then it builds — in your own Kissflow development environment, with your permissions — and tests every journey, for every role.
Every build is a version. Nothing reaches production on its own.
